using Makie

function makeplot(x, y)
    fig = Figure(size = (720, 480))
    
    ax1 = Axis(fig[1, 1], title = "Signal", ylabel = "Amplitude")
    ax2 = Axis(fig[2, 1], xlabel = "Time (s)", ylabel = "Magnitude")
    
    lines!(ax1, x, y)
    scatter!(ax2, x, abs.(y))
    
    linkxaxes!(ax1, ax2)
    
    return (fig, ax1, ax2)
